verses.original: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌۭ وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا وَقَدْ بَلَغْتُ مِنَ ٱلْكِبَرِ عِتِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Qaala Rabbi annaa yakoonu lee ghulaamunw wa kaanatim ra atee aaqiranw wa qad balaghtu minal kibari 'itiyyaa
verses.translation: He said: My Lord! How can I have a son when my wife is barren and I have reached infirm old age?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌۭ وَقَدْ خَلَقْتُكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ تَكُ شَيْـًۭٔا
verses.translit: Qaala kazaalika qaala Rabbuka huwa 'alaiya haiyinunw wa qad khalaqtuka min qablu wa lam taku shai'aa
verses.translation: He said: So (it will be). Thy Lord saith: It is easy for Me, even as I created thee before, when thou wast naught.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجْعَل لِّىٓ ءَايَةًۭ ۚ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَٰثَ لَيَالٍۢ سَوِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Qaala Rabbij 'al leee Aayah; qaala Aayatuka allaa tukalliman naasa salaasa layaalin sawiyyaa
verses.translation: He said: My Lord! Appoint for me some token. He said: Thy token is that thou, with no bodily defect, shalt not speak unto mankind three nights.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْمِحْرَابِ فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِمْ أَن سَبِّحُوا۟ بُكْرَةًۭ وَعَشِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Fakharaja 'alaa qawmihee minal mihraabi fa-awhaaa ilaihim an sabbihoo bukratanw wa 'ashiyyaa
verses.translation: Then he came forth unto his people from the sanctuary, and signified to them: Glorify your Lord at break of day and fall of night.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَٰيَحْيَىٰ خُذِ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِقُوَّةٍۢ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحُكْمَ صَبِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Yaa Yahyaa khuzil Kitaaba biquwwatinw wa aatainaahul hukma saiyyaa
verses.translation: (And it was said unto his son): O John! Hold fast the Scripture. And we gave him wisdom when a child,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَحَنَانًۭا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَزَكَوٰةًۭ ۖ وَكَانَ تَقِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Wa hanaanam mil ladunnaa wa zakaatanw wa kaana taqiyyaa
verses.translation: And compassion from Our presence, and purity; and he was devout,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُن جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Wa barram biwaalidayhi wa lam yakum jabbaaran 'asiyyaa
verses.translation: And dutiful toward his parents. And he was not arrogant, rebellious.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّۭا
verses.translit: Wa salaamun 'alaihi yawma wulida wa yawma yamootu wa yawma yub'asu haiyaa
verses.translation: Peace on him the day he was born, and the day he dieth and the day he shall be raised alive!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًۭا شَرْقِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Wazkur fil Kitaabi Marya; izin tabazat min ahlihaa makaanan shariqyyaa
verses.translation: And make mention of Mary in the Scripture, when she had withdrawn from her people to a chamber looking East,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٱتَّخَذَتْ مِن دُونِهِمْ حِجَابًۭا فَأَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًۭا سَوِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Fattakhazat min doonihim hijaaban fa arsalnaaa ilaihaa roohanaa fatamassala lahaa basharan sawiyyaa
verses.translation: And had chosen seclusion from them. Then We sent unto her Our Spirit and it assumed for her the likeness of a perfect man.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَتْ إِنِّىٓ أَعُوذُ بِٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Qaalat inneee a'oozu bir Rahmaani minka in kunta taqiyyaa
verses.translation: She said: Lo! I seek refuge in the Beneficent One from thee, if thou art Allah-fearing.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَٰمًۭا زَكِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Qaala innamaa ana rasoolu Rabbiki li ahaba laki ghulaaman zakiyyaa
verses.translation: He said: I am only a messenger of thy Lord, that I may bestow on thee a faultless son.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَتْ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌۭ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌۭ وَلَمْ أَكُ بَغِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Qaalat anna yakoonu lee ghulaamunw wa lam yamsasnee bashrunw wa lam aku baghiyyaa
verses.translation: She said: How can I have a son when no mortal hath touched me, neither have I been unchaste?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌۭ ۖ وَلِنَجْعَلَهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرًۭا مَّقْضِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Qaala kazaaliki qaala Rabbuki huwa 'alaiya yaiyimunw wa linaj 'alahooo Aayatal linnaasi wa rahmatam minnaa; wa kaana amram maqdiyyaa
verses.translation: He said: So (it will be). Thy Lord saith: It is easy for Me. And (it will be) that We may make of him a revelation for mankind and a mercy from Us, and it is a thing ordained.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَٱنتَبَذَتْ بِهِۦ مَكَانًۭا قَصِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Fahamalat hu fantabazat bihee makaanan qasiyyaa
verses.translation: And she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a far place.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَجَآءَهَا ٱلْمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَٰلَيْتَنِى مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَٰذَا وَكُنتُ نَسْيًۭا مَّنسِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Fa ajaaa 'ahal makhaadu ilaa jiz'in nakhlati qaalat yaa laitanee mittu qabla haazaa wa kuntu nasyam mansiyyaa
verses.translation: And the pangs of childbirth drove her unto the trunk of the palm-tree. She said: Oh, would that I had died ere this and had become a thing of naught, forgotten!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحْزَنِى قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Fanaadaahaa min tahtihaan allaa tahzanee qad ja'ala Rabbuki tahtaki sariyyaa
verses.translation: Then (one) cried unto her from below her, saying: Grieve not! Thy Lord hath placed a rivulet beneath thee,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَهُزِّىٓ إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ تُسَٰقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًۭا جَنِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Wa huzzeee ilaiki bijiz 'in nakhlati tusaaqit 'alaiki rutaban janiyyaa
verses.translation: And shake the trunk of the palm-tree toward thee, thou wilt cause ripe dates to fall upon thee.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَكُلِى وَٱشْرَبِى وَقَرِّى عَيْنًۭا ۖ فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ ٱلْبَشَرِ أَحَدًۭا فَقُولِىٓ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ صَوْمًۭا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِنسِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Fakulee washrabee wa qarree 'ainaa; fa immaa tarayinnna minal bashari ahadan faqooleee innee nazartu lir Rahmaani sawman falan ukallimal yawma insiyyaa
verses.translation: So eat and drink and be consoled. And if thou meetest any mortal, say: Lo! I have vowed a fast unto the Beneficent, and may not speak this day to any mortal.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَتَتْ بِهِۦ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُۥ ۖ قَالُوا۟ يَٰمَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْـًۭٔا فَرِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Fa atat bihee qawmahaa tahmiluhoo qaaloo yaa Maryamoo laqad ji'ti shai'an fariyyaa
verses.translation: Then she brought him to her own folk, carrying him. They said: O Mary! Thou hast come with an amazing thing.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَٰٓأُخْتَ هَٰرُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ ٱمْرَأَ سَوْءٍۢ وَمَا كَانَتْ أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Yaaa ukkhta Haaroona maa kaana abokim ra-a saw'inw wa maa kaanat ummuki baghiyyaa
verses.translation: O sister of Aaron! Thy father was not a wicked man nor was thy mother a harlot.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ ۖ قَالُوا۟ كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Fa ashaarat ilaih; qaaloo kaifa nukallimu man kaana fil mahdi sabiyyaa
verses.translation: Then she pointed to him. They said: How can we talk to one who is in the cradle, a young boy?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ إِنِّى عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ ءَاتَىٰنِىَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِى نَبِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Qaala innee 'abdullaahi aataaniyal Kitaaba wa ja'alanee Nabiyyaa
verses.translation: He spake: Lo! I am the slave of Allah. He hath given me the Scripture and hath appointed me a Prophet,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَجَعَلَنِى مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوْصَٰنِى بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّۭا
verses.translit: Wa ja'alanee mubaarakan aina maa kuntu wa awsaanee bis Salaati waz Zakaati maa dumtu haiyaa
verses.translation: And hath made me blessed wheresoever I may be, and hath enjoined upon me prayer and almsgiving so long as I remain alive,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِى وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِى جَبَّارًۭا شَقِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Wa barram biwaalidatee wa lam yaj'alnee jabbaaran shaqiyyaa
verses.translation: And (hath made me) dutiful toward her who bore me, and hath not made me arrogant, unblest.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّۭا
verses.translit: Wassalaamu 'alaiya yawma wulittu wa yawma amootu wa yawma ub'asu baiyaa
verses.translation: Peace on me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I shall be raised alive!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ ۚ قَوْلَ ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
verses.translit: Zaalika 'Eesab-nu Marya; qawlal haqqil lazee feehi yamtaroon
verses.translation: Such was Jesus, son of Mary: (this is) a statement of the truth concerning which they doubt.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدٍۢ ۖ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥٓ ۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًۭا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verses.translit: Maa kaana lillaahi ai yattakhiza minw waladin Subhaanah; izaa qadaaa amran fa innamaa yaqoolu lahoo kun fa yakoon
verses.translation: It befitteth not (the Majesty of) Allah that He should take unto Himself a son. Glory be to Him! When He decreeth a thing, He saith unto it only: Be! and it is.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
verses.translit: Wa innal laaha Rabbee wa Rabbukum fa'budooh; haazaa Siraatum Mustaqeem
verses.translation: And lo! Allah is my Lord and your Lord. So serve Him. That is the right path.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن مَّشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.translit: Fakhtalafal ahzaabu mim bainihim fawailul lillazeena kafaroo mim mashhadi Yawmin 'azeem
verses.translation: The sects among them differ: but woe unto the disbelievers from the meeting of an awful Day.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَأَبْصِرْ يَوْمَ يَأْتُونَنَا ۖ لَٰكِنِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.translit: Asmi' bihim wa absir Yawma yaatoonanaa laakiniz zaalimoonal yawma fee dalaalim mubeen
verses.translation: See and hear them on the Day they come unto Us! yet the evil-doers are to-day in error manifest.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْحَسْرَةِ إِذْ قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ وَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.translit: Wa anzirhum Yawmal hasrati iz qudiyal amr; wa hum fee ghaflatinw wa hum laa yu'minoon
verses.translation: And warn them of the Day of anguish when the case hath been decided. Now they are in a state of carelessness, and they believe not.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ
verses.translit: Innaa NNahnu narisul arda wa man 'alaihaa wa ilainaa yurja'oon
verses.translation: Lo! We, only We, inherit the earth and all who are thereon, and unto Us they are returned.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًۭا نَّبِيًّا
verses.translit: Wazkur fil Kitaabi Ibraaheem; innahoo kaana siddeeqan Nabiyyaa
verses.translation: And make mention (O Muhammad) in the Scripture of Abraham. Lo! he was a saint, a prophet.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَٰٓأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنكَ شَيْـًۭٔا
verses.translit: Iz qaala li abeehi yaaa abati lima ta'budu maa laa yasma'u wa laa yubsiru wa laa yughnee 'anka shai'aa
verses.translation: When he said unto his father: O my father! Why worshippest thou that which heareth not nor seeth, nor can in aught avail thee?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى قَدْ جَآءَنِى مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَٱتَّبِعْنِىٓ أَهْدِكَ صِرَٰطًۭا سَوِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Yaaa abati innee qad jaaa'anee minal 'ilmi maa lam yaatika fattabi'neee ahdika siraatan Sawiyyaa
verses.translation: O my father! Lo! there hath come unto me of knowledge that which came not unto thee. So follow me, and I will lead thee on a right path.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَٰٓأَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَصِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Yaaa abati laa ta'budish Shaitaana innash Shaitaana kaana lir Rahmaani 'asiyyaa
verses.translation: O my father! Serve not the devil. Lo! the devil is a rebel unto the Beneficent.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيْطَٰنِ وَلِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Yaaa abati innee akhaafu ai yamssaka 'azaabum minar Rahmaani fatakoona lish Shaitaani waliyyaa
verses.translation: O my father! Lo! I fear lest a punishment from the Beneficent overtake thee so that thou become a comrade of the devil.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنتَ عَنْ ءَالِهَتِى يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ ۖ وَٱهْجُرْنِى مَلِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Qaala araaghibun anta 'an aalihatee yaaa Ibraaheemu la 'il lam tantahi la arjumannaka wahjumee maliyyaa
verses.translation: He said: Rejectest thou my gods, O Abraham? If thou cease not, I shall surely stone thee. Depart from me a long while!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكَ ۖ سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِى حَفِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Qaala salaamun 'alaika sa astaghfiru laka Rabbeee innahoo kaana bee hafiyyaa
verses.translation: He said: Peace be unto thee! I shall ask forgiveness of my Lord for thee. Lo! He was ever gracious unto me.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّى شَقِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Wa a'tazilukum wa maa tad'oona min doonil laahi wa ad'o Rabbee 'asaaa allaaa akoona bidu'aaa'i Rabbee shaqiyyaa
verses.translation: I shall withdraw from you and that unto which ye pray beside Allah, and I shall pray unto my Lord. It may be that, in prayer unto my Lord, I shall not be unblest.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَلَمَّا ٱعْتَزَلَهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَكُلًّۭا جَعَلْنَا نَبِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Falamma' tazalahum wa maa ya'budoona min doonil laahi wahabnaa lahoo is-haaqa wa ya'qoob, wa kullan ja'alnaa Nabiyyaa
verses.translation: So, when he had withdrawn from them and that which they were worshipping beside Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob. Each of them We made a prophet.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Wa wahabnaa lahum mirrahmatinaa wa ja'alnaa lahum lisaana sidqin 'aliyyaa
verses.translation: And we gave them of Our mercy, and assigned to them a high and true renown.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مُخْلَصًۭا وَكَانَ رَسُولًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Wazkur fil Kitaabi Moosaaa; innahoo kaana mukhlasanw wa kaana Rasoolan Nabiyyaa
verses.translation: And make mention in the Scripture of Moses. Lo! he was chosen, and he was a messenger (of Allah), a prophet.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَنَٰدَيْنَٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَٰهُ نَجِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Wa naadainaahu min jaanibit Tooril aimani wa qarrabnaahu najiyyaa
verses.translation: We called him from the right slope of the Mount, and brought him nigh in communion.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ مِن رَّحْمَتِنَآ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ نَبِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Wa wahabnaa lahoo mir rahmatinaaa akhaahu Haaroona Nabiyyaa
verses.translation: And We bestowed upon him of Our mercy his brother Aaron, a prophet (likewise).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Wazkur fil Kitaabi ismaa'eel; innahoo kaana saadiqal wa'di wa kaana Rasoolan Nabiyyaa
verses.translation: And make mention in the Scripture of Ishmael. Lo! he was a keeper of his promise, and he was a messenger (of Allah), a prophet.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُۥ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ مَرْضِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Wa kaana yaamuru ahlahoo bis Salaati waz zakaati wa kaana 'inda Rabbihee mardiyyaa
verses.translation: He enjoined upon his people worship and almsgiving, and was acceptable in the sight of his Lord.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِدْرِيسَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Wazkur fil Kitaabi Idrees; innahoo kaana siddeeqan Nabiyyaa
verses.translation: And make mention in the Scripture of Idris. Lo! he was a saint, a prophet;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَرَفَعْنَٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا
verses.translit: Wa rafa'naahu makaanan 'aliyyaa
verses.translation: And We raised him to high station.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍۢ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَٱجْتَبَيْنَآ ۚ إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًۭا وَبُكِيًّۭا ۩
verses.translit: Ulaaa'ikal lazeena an'amal laahu 'alaihim minan Nabiyyeena min zurriyyati Aadama wa mimman hamalnaa ma'a Noohinw wa min zurriyyati Ibraaheema wa Israaa'eela wa mimman hadainaa wajta bainaaa; izaa tutlaa 'alaihim Aayaatur Rahmaani kharroo sujjadanw wa bukiyyaa
verses.translation: These are they unto whom Allah showed favour from among the prophets, of the seed of Adam and of those whom We carried (in the ship) with Noah, and of the seed of Abraham and Israel, and from among those whom We guided and chose. When the revelations of the Beneficent were recited unto them, they fell down, adoring and weeping.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا
verses.translit: Fakhalafa mim ba'dihim khalfun adaa'us Salaata wattaba'ush shahawaati fasawfa yalqawna ghaiyaa
verses.translation: Now there hath succeeded them a later generation whom have ruined worship and have followed lusts. But they will meet deception.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَيْـًۭٔا
verses.translit: Illaa man taaba wa aamana wa 'amila saalihan fa ulaaa'ika yadkhuloonal jannata wa laa yuzlamoona shai'aa
verses.translation: Save him who shall repent and believe and do right. Such will enter the Garden, and they will not be wronged in aught -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَأْتِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Jannaati 'adninil latee wa'adar Rahmaanu ibaadahoo bilghaib; innahoo kaana wa'duhoo maatiyyaa
verses.translation: Gardens of Eden, which the Beneficent hath promised to His slaves in the unseen. Lo! His promise is ever sure of fulfilment -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا إِلَّا سَلَٰمًۭا ۖ وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةًۭ وَعَشِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Laa yasma'oona feehaa laghwan illaa salaamaa; wa lahum rizquhum feehaa bukratanw wa 'ashiyyaa
verses.translation: They hear therein no idle talk, but only Peace; and therein they have food for morn and evening.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: تِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِى نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Tilkal jannatul latee oorisu min 'ibaadinaa man kaana taqiyyaa
verses.translation: Such is the Garden which We cause the devout among Our bondmen to inherit.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ ۖ لَهُۥ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Wa maa natanazzalu illaa bi amri Rabbika lahoo maa baina aideenaa wa maa khalfanaa wa maa baina zaalik; wa maa kaana Rabbuka nasiyyaa
verses.translation: We (angels) come not down save by commandment of thy Lord. Unto Him belongeth all that is before us and all that is behind us and all that is between those two, and thy Lord was never forgetful -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَٱعْبُدْهُ وَٱصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَٰدَتِهِۦ ۚ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Rabbus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa fa'bud hu wastabir li'ibaadatih; hal ta'lamu lahoo samiyyaa
verses.translation: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them! Therefor, worship thou Him and be thou steadfast in His service. Knowest thou one that can be named along with Him?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَيَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ أُخْرَجُ حَيًّا
verses.translit: Wa yaqoolul insaanu 'aizaa maa mittu lasawfa ukhraju haiyaa
verses.translation: And man saith: When I am dead, shall I forsooth be brought forth alive?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْـًۭٔا
verses.translit: awalaa yazkurul insaanu annaa khalaqnaahu min qablu wa lam yaku shai'aa
verses.translation: Doth not man remember that We created him before, when he was naught?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Fawa Rabbika lanahshu rannahum wash shayaateena summa lanuhdirannahum hawla jahannama jisiyyaa
verses.translation: And, by thy Lord, verily We shall assemble them and the devils, then We shall bring them, crouching, around hell.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عِتِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Summa lananzi 'anna min kulli shee'atin aiyuhum ashaddu 'alar Rahmaani 'itiyyaa
verses.translation: Then We shall pluck out from every sect whichever of them was most stubborn in rebellion to the Beneficent.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Summa lanahnu a'lamu billazeena hum awlaa bihaa siliyyaa
verses.translation: And surely We are Best Aware of those most worthy to be burned therein.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِن مِّنكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتْمًۭا مَّقْضِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Wa im minkum illaa waa riduhaa; kaana 'alaa Rabbika hatmam maqdiyyaa
verses.translation: There is not one of you but shall approach it. That is a fixed ordinance of thy Lord.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Summa nunajjil lazeenat taqaw wa nazaruz zaalimeena feehaa jisiyyaa
verses.translation: Then We shall rescue those who kept from evil, and leave the evil-doers crouching there.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَىُّ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٌۭ مَّقَامًۭا وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّۭا
verses.translit: Wa izaa tutlaa 'alaihim Aayaatunaa baiyinaatin qaalal lazeena kafaroo lillazeena aamanooo aiyul fareeqaini khairum maqaamanw wa ahsanu nadiyyaa
verses.translation: And when Our clear revelations are recited unto them, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Which of the two parties (yours or ours) is better in position, and more imposing as an army?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَحْسَنُ أَثَٰثًۭا وَرِءْيًۭا
verses.translit: Wa kam ahlaknaa qablahum min qarnin hum ahsanu asaasanw wa ri'yaa
verses.translation: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, who were more imposing in respect of gear and outward seeming!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلضَّلَٰلَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مَدًّا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّۭ مَّكَانًۭا وَأَضْعَفُ جُندًۭا
verses.translit: Qul man kaana fidda laalati falyamdud lahur Rahmaanu maddaa; hattaaa izaa ra aw maa yoo'adoona immal 'azaaba wa immas Saa'ata fasa ya'lamoona man huwa sharrum makaananw wa ad'afu jundaa
verses.translation: Say: As for him who is in error, the Beneficent will verily prolong his span of life until, when they behold that which they were promised, whether it be punishment (in the world), or the Hour (of doom), they will know who is worse in position and who is weaker as an army.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَيَزِيدُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱهْتَدَوْا۟ هُدًۭى ۗ وَٱلْبَٰقِيَٰتُ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًۭا وَخَيْرٌۭ مَّرَدًّا
verses.translit: Wa yazeedul laahul lazeenah tadaw hudaa; wal baaqiyaatus saalihaatu khairun 'inda Rabbika sawaabanw wa khairum maraddaa
verses.translation: Allah increaseth in right guidance those who walk aright, and the good deeds which endure are better in thy Lord's sight for reward, and better for resort.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالًۭا وَوَلَدًا
verses.translit: Afara'aytal lazee kafara bi Aayaatinaa wa qaala la oota yanna maalanw wa waladaa
verses.translation: Hast thou seen him who disbelieveth in Our revelations and saith: Assuredly I shall be given wealth and children?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَطَّلَعَ ٱلْغَيْبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًۭا
verses.translit: Attala'al ghaiba amitta khaza'indar Rahmaani 'ahdaa
verses.translation: Hath he perused the Unseen, or hath he made a pact with the Beneficent?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كَلَّا ۚ سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ مَدًّۭا
verses.translit: Kallaa; sanaktubu maa yaqoolu wa namuddu lahoo minal 'azaabi maddaa
verses.translation: Nay, but We shall record that which he saith and prolong for him a span of torment.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَنَرِثُهُۥ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًۭا
verses.translit: Wa narisuhoo maa yaqoolu wa yaateenaa fardaa
verses.translation: And We shall inherit from him that whereof he spake, and he will come unto Us, alone (without his wealth and children).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةًۭ لِّيَكُونُوا۟ لَهُمْ عِزًّۭا
verses.translit: Wattakhazoo min doonil laahi aalihatal liyakoonoo lahum 'izzaa
verses.translation: And they have chosen (other) gods beside Allah that they may be a power for them.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كَلَّا ۚ سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا
verses.translit: Kallaa; sa yakfuroona bi'ibaadatihim wa yakoonoona 'alaihim diddaa
verses.translation: Nay, but they will deny their worship of them, and become opponents unto them.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّۭا
verses.translit: Alam tara annaaa arsalnash Shayaateena 'alal kaafireena ta'uzzuhum azzaa
verses.translation: Seest thou not that We have set the devils on the disbelievers to confound them with confusion?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّۭا
verses.translit: Falaa ta'jal alaihim innamaa na 'uddu lahum 'addaa
verses.translation: So make no haste against them (O Muhammad). We do but number unto them a sum (of days).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَفْدًۭا
verses.translit: Yawma nahshurul muttaqeena ilar Rahmaani wafdaa
verses.translation: On the day when We shall gather the righteous unto the Beneficent, a goodly company.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَنَسُوقُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًۭا
verses.translit: Wa nasooqul mujrimeena ilaa Jahannama wirdaa
verses.translation: And drive the guilty unto hell, a weary herd,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَّا يَمْلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًۭا
verses.translit: Laa yamlikoonash shafaa'ta illaa manittakhaza 'indar Rahmaani 'ahdaa
verses.translation: They will have no power of intercession, save him who hath made a covenant with his Lord.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَلَدًۭا
verses.translit: Wa qaalut takhazar Rahmaanu waladaa
verses.translation: And they say: The Beneficent hath taken unto Himself a son.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِدًّۭا
verses.translit: Laqad ji'tum shai'an iddaa
verses.translation: Assuredly ye utter a disastrous thing
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلْجِبَالُ هَدًّا
verses.translit: Takaadus samaawaatu yatafattarna minhu wa tanshaq qul ardu wa takhirrul jibaalu haddaa
verses.translation: Whereby almost the heavens are torn, and the earth is split asunder and the mountains fall in ruins,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَن دَعَوْا۟ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَدًۭا
verses.translit: An da'aw lir Rahmaani waladaa
verses.translation: That ye ascribe unto the Beneficent a son,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا
verses.translit: Wa maa yambaghee lir Rahmaani ai yattakhiza waladaa
verses.translation: When it is not meet for (the Majesty of) the Beneficent that He should choose a son.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَبْدًۭا
verses.translit: In kullu man fis samaawaati wal ardi illaaa aatir Rahmaani 'abdaa
verses.translation: There is none in the heavens and the earth but cometh unto the Beneficent as a slave.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَّقَدْ أَحْصَىٰهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّۭا
verses.translit: Laqad ahsaahum wa addahum 'addaa
verses.translation: Verily He knoweth them and numbereth them with (right) numbering.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَكُلُّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فَرْدًا
verses.translit: Wa kulluhum aateehi Yawmal Qiyaamati fardaa
verses.translation: And each one of them will come unto Him on the Day of Resurrection, alone.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وُدًّۭا
verses.translit: Innal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati sa yaj'alu lahumur Rahmaanu wuddaa
verses.translation: Lo! those who believe and do good works, the Beneficent will appoint for them love.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ قَوْمًۭا لُّدًّۭا
verses.translit: Fa innamaa yassarnaahu bilisaanika litubashshira bihil muttaqeena wa tunzira bihee qawmal luddaa
verses.translation: And We make (this Scripture) easy in thy tongue, (O Muhammad) only that thou mayst bear good tidings therewith unto those who ward off (evil), and warn therewith the froward folk.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًۢا
verses.translit: Wa kam ahlaknaa qabla hum min qarnin hal tuhissu minhum min ahadin aw tasma'u lahum rikzaa
verses.translation: And how many a generation before them have We destroyed! Canst thou (Muhammad) see a single man of them, or hear from them the slightest sound?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ طه
verses.translit: Taa-Haa
verses.translation: Ta. Ha.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِتَشْقَىٰٓ
verses.translit: Maaa anzalnaa 'alaikal Qur-aana litashqaaa
verses.translation: We have not revealed unto thee (Muhammad) this Qur'an that thou shouldst be distressed,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِلَّا تَذْكِرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰ
verses.translit: Illaa tazkiratal limany yakshaa
verses.translation: But as a reminder unto him who feareth,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: تَنزِيلًۭا مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلْعُلَى
verses.translit: Tanzeelam mimman khalaqal arda was samaawaatil 'ulaa
verses.translation: A revelation from Him Who created the earth and the high heavens,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱسْتَوَىٰ
verses.translit: Ar-Rahmaanu 'alal 'Arshis tawaa
verses.translation: The Beneficent One, Who is established on the Throne.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحْتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ
verses.translit: Lahoo maa fis samaawaati wa maa fil ardi wa maa bainahumaa wa maa tahtassaraa
verses.translation: Unto Him belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, and whatsoever is between them, and whatsoever is beneath the sod.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِن تَجْهَرْ بِٱلْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخْفَى
verses.translit: Wa in tajhar bilqawli fainnahoo ya'lamus sirra wa akhfaa
verses.translation: And if thou speakest aloud, then lo! He knoweth the secret (thought) and (that which is yet) more hidden.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
verses.translit: Allaahu laaa ilasha illaa Huwa lahul Asmaaa'ul Husnaa
verses.translation: Allah! There is no Allah save Him. His are the most beautiful names.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
verses.translit: Wa hal ataaka hadeesu Moosa
verses.translation: Hath there come unto thee the story of Moses?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِذْ رَءَا نَارًۭا فَقَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ ٱمْكُثُوٓا۟ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًۭا لَّعَلِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوْ أَجِدُ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ هُدًۭى
verses.translit: Iz ra aa naaran faqaala li alhlihim kusooo inneee aanastu naaral la'alleee aateekum minhaa biqabasin aw ajidu 'alan naari hudaa
verses.translation: When he saw a fire and said unto his folk: Lo! Wait! I see a fire afar off. Peradventure I may bring you a brand therefrom or may find guidance at the fire.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِىَ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ
verses.translit: Falammaaa ataahaa noodiya yaa Moosaa
verses.translation: And when he reached it, he was called by name: O Moses!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنِّىٓ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكَ فَٱخْلَعْ نَعْلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًۭى
verses.translit: Inneee Ana Rabbuka fakhla' na'laika innaka bilwaadil muqaddasi Tuwaa
verses.translation: Lo! I, even I, am thy Lord, So take off thy shoes, for lo! thou art in the holy valley of Tuwa.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنَا ٱخْتَرْتُكَ فَٱسْتَمِعْ لِمَا يُوحَىٰٓ
verses.translit: Wa anakhtartuka fastami' limaa yoohaa
verses.translation: And I have chosen thee, so hearken unto that which is inspired.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّنِىٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدْنِى وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكْرِىٓ
verses.translit: Innaneee Anal laahu laaa ilaaha illaa Ana fa'budnee wa aqimis-salaata lizikree
verses.translation: Lo! I, even I, am Allah, There is no Allah save Me. So serve Me and establish worship for My remembrance.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخْفِيهَا لِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا تَسْعَىٰ
verses.translit: Innas Saa'ata aatiyatun akaadu ukhfeehaa litujzaa kullu nafsim bimaa tas'aa
verses.translation: Lo! the Hour is surely coming. But I will to keep it hidden, that every soul may be rewarded for that which it striveth (to achieve).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنْهَا مَن لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرْدَىٰ
verses.translit: Falaa yasuddannnaka 'anhaa mal laa yu'minu bihaa wattaba'a hawaahu fatardaa
verses.translation: Therefor, let not him turn thee aside from (the thought of) it who believeth not therein but followeth his own desire, lest thou perish.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا تِلْكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.translit: Wa maa tilka bi yamee nika yaa Moosaa
verses.translation: And what is that in thy right hand, O Moses?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ هِىَ عَصَاىَ أَتَوَكَّؤُا۟ عَلَيْهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِى وَلِىَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخْرَىٰ
verses.translit: Qaala hiya 'asaaya atawakka'u alaihaa wa ahushshu bihaa 'alaa ghanamee wa liya feehaa ma aaribu ukhraa
verses.translation: He said: This is my staff whereon I lean, and wherewith I bear down branches for my sheep, and wherein I find other uses.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ أَلْقِهَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.translit: Qaala alqihaa yaa Moosaa
verses.translation: He said: Cast it down, O Moses!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَلْقَىٰهَا فَإِذَا هِىَ حَيَّةٌۭ تَسْعَىٰ
verses.translit: Fa-alqaahaa fa -izaa hiya haiyatun tas'aa
verses.translation: So he cast it down, and lo! it was a serpent, gliding.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ خُذْهَا وَلَا تَخَفْ ۖ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.translit: Qaala khuzhaa wa laa ta khaf sanu'eeduhaa seeratahal oolaa
verses.translation: He said: Grasp it and fear not. We shall return it to its former state.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱضْمُمْ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً أُخْرَىٰ
verses.translit: Wadmum yadaka ilaa janaahika takhruj baidaaa'a min ghairi sooo'in Aayatan ukhraa
verses.translation: And thrust thy hand within thine armpit, it will come forth white without hurt. (That will be) another token.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا ٱلْكُبْرَى
verses.translit: Linuriyaka min Aayaatinal Kubra
verses.translation: That We may show thee (some) of Our greater portents,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
verses.translit: Izhab ilaa Fir'awna innahoo taghaa
verses.translation: Go thou unto Pharaoh! Lo! he hath transgressed (the bounds).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشْرَحْ لِى صَدْرِى
verses.translit: Qaala Rabbish rah lee sadree
verses.translation: (Moses) said: My Lord! relieve my mind
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَيَسِّرْ لِىٓ أَمْرِى
verses.translit: Wa yassir leee amree
verses.translation: And ease my task for me;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱحْلُلْ عُقْدَةًۭ مِّن لِّسَانِى
verses.translit: Wahlul 'uqdatam milli saanee
verses.translation: And loose a knot from my tongue,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَفْقَهُوا۟ قَوْلِى
verses.translit: Yafqahoo qawlee
verses.translation: That they may understand my saying.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱجْعَل لِّى وَزِيرًۭا مِّنْ أَهْلِى
verses.translit: Waj'al lee wazeeram min ahlee
verses.translation: Appoint for me a henchman from my folk,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: هَٰرُونَ أَخِى
verses.translit: Haaroona akhee
verses.translation: Aaron, my brother.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱشْدُدْ بِهِۦٓ أَزْرِى
verses.translit: Ushdud biheee azree
verses.translation: Confirm my strength with him
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَشْرِكْهُ فِىٓ أَمْرِى
verses.translit: Wa ashrik hu feee amree
verses.translation: And let him share my task,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كَىْ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرًۭا
verses.translit: Kai nusabbihaka kaseeraa
verses.translation: That we may glorify Thee much
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَنَذْكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا
verses.translit: Wa nazkuraka kaseeraa
verses.translation: And much remember Thee.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرًۭا
verses.translit: Innaka kunta binaa baseeraa
verses.translation: Lo! Thou art ever Seeing us.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ قَدْ أُوتِيتَ سُؤْلَكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.translit: Qaala qad ooteeta su'laka yaa Moosaa
verses.translation: He said: Thou art granted thy request, O Moses.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَيْكَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَىٰٓ
verses.translit: Wa laqad manannaa 'alaika marratan ukhraaa
verses.translation: And indeed, another time, already We have shown thee favour,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِذْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ
verses.translit: Iz awhainaaa ilaaa ummika maa yoohaaa
verses.translation: When we inspired in thy mother that which is inspired,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَنِ ٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ فَلْيُلْقِهِ ٱلْيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأْخُذْهُ عَدُوٌّۭ لِّى وَعَدُوٌّۭ لَّهُۥ ۚ وَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةًۭ مِّنِّى وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيْنِىٓ
verses.translit: Aniqzifeehi fit Taabooti faqzifeehi fil yammi fal yul qihil yammu bis saahili yaakhuzhu 'aduwwul lee wa 'aduwwul lah; wa alqaitu 'alaika mahabbatam minnee wa litusna'a 'alaa 'ainee
verses.translation: Saying: Throw him into the ark, and throw it into the river, then the river shall throw it on to the bank, and there an enemy to Me and an enemy to him shall take him. And I endued thee with love from Me that thou mightest be trained according to My will,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِذْ تَمْشِىٓ أُخْتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكْفُلُهُۥ ۖ فَرَجَعْنَٰكَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ كَىْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ ۚ وَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًۭا فَنَجَّيْنَٰكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّٰكَ فُتُونًۭا ۚ فَلَبِثْتَ سِنِينَ فِىٓ أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئْتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرٍۢ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.translit: Iz tamsheee ukhtuka fataqoolu hal adullukum 'alaa mai yakfuluhoo faraja 'naaka ilaaa ummika kai taqarra 'ainuhaa wa laa tahzan; wa qatalta nafsan fanajjainaaka minal ghammi wa fatannaaka futoonaa; falabista sineena feee ahli Madyana summa ji'ta 'alaa qadariny yaa Moosa
verses.translation: When thy sister went and said: Shall I show you one who will nurse him? and we restored thee to thy mother that her eyes might be refreshed and might not sorrow. And thou didst kill a man and We delivered thee from great distress, and tried thee with a heavy trial. And thou didst tarry years among the folk of Midian. Then camest thou (hither) by (My) providence, O Moses,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱصْطَنَعْتُكَ لِنَفْسِى
verses.translit: Wastana' tuka linafsee
verses.translation: And I have attached thee to Myself.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِـَٔايَٰتِى وَلَا تَنِيَا فِى ذِكْرِى
verses.translit: Izhab anta wa akhooka bi Aayaatee wa laa taniyaa fee zikree
verses.translation: Go, thou and thy brother, with My tokens, and be not faint in remembrance of Me.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
verses.translit: Izhabaaa ilaa Fir'awna innahoo taghaa
verses.translation: Go, both of you, unto Pharaoh. Lo! he hath transgressed (the bounds).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوْلًۭا لَّيِّنًۭا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوْ يَخْشَىٰ
verses.translit: Faqoolaa lahoo qawlal laiyinal la allahoo yatazakkkaru 'aw yakhshaa
verses.translation: And speak unto him a gentle word, that peradventure he may heed or fear.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَا رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَآ أَوْ أَن يَطْغَىٰ
verses.translit: Qaalaa Rabbanaaa innanaa nakhaafu ai yafruta 'alainaaa aw ai yatghaa
verses.translation: They said: Our Lord! Lo! we fear that he may be beforehand with us or that he may play the tyrant.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآ ۖ إِنَّنِى مَعَكُمَآ أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ
verses.translit: Qaala laa takhaafaaa innanee ma'akumaa asma'u wa araa
verses.translation: He said: Fear not. Lo! I am with you twain, Hearing and Seeing.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأْتِيَاهُ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبْهُمْ ۖ قَدْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِـَٔايَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۖ وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
verses.translit: Faatiyaahu faqoolaaa innaa Rasoolaa Rabbika fa arsil ma'anaa Banee Israaa'eela wa laa tu'azzibhum qad ji'naaka bi Aayatim mir Rabbika wassa laamu 'alaa manit taba'al hudaa
verses.translation: So go ye unto him and say: Lo! we are two messengers of thy Lord. So let the children of Israel go with us, and torment them not. We bring thee a token from thy Lord. And peace will be for him who followeth right guidance.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّا قَدْ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْنَآ أَنَّ ٱلْعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
verses.translit: Innaa qad oohiya ilainaaa annnal 'azaaba 'alaa man kaz zaba wa tawalla
verses.translation: Lo! it hath been revealed unto us that the doom will be for him who denieth and turneth away.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ فَمَن رَّبُّكُمَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.translit: Qaala famar Rabbu kumaa yaa Moosa
verses.translation: (Pharaoh) said: Who then is the Lord of you twain, O Moses?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ رَبُّنَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَعْطَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلْقَهُۥ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ
verses.translit: Qaala Rabbunal lazeee a'taa kulla shai'in khalqahoo summa hadaa
verses.translation: He said: Our Lord is He Who gave unto everything its nature, then guided it aright.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ ٱلْقُرُونِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.translit: Qaala famaa baalul quroonil oolaa
verses.translation: He said: What then is the state of the generations of old?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ عِلْمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّى فِى كِتَٰبٍۢ ۖ لَّا يَضِلُّ رَبِّى وَلَا يَنسَى
verses.translit: Qaala 'ilmuhaa 'inda Rabee fee kitaab, laa yadillu Rabbee wa laa yansaa
verses.translation: He said: The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a Record. My Lord neither erreth nor forgetteth,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًۭا وَسَلَكَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًۭا وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًۭا مِّن نَّبَاتٍۢ شَتَّىٰ
verses.translit: Allazee ja'ala lakumul arda mahdanw wa salaka lakum feehaa subulanw wa anzala minas samaaa'i maaa'an fa akhrajnaa biheee azwaajam min nabaatin shatta
verses.translation: Who hath appointed the earth as a bed and hath threaded roads for you therein and hath sent down water from the sky and thereby We have brought forth divers kinds of vegetation,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كُلُوا۟ وَٱرْعَوْا۟ أَنْعَٰمَكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلنُّهَىٰ
verses.translit: Kuloo war'aw an'aamakum; inna fee zaalika la Aayaatil li ulin nuhaa
verses.translation: (Saying): Eat ye and feed your cattle. Lo! herein verily are portents for men of thought.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ مِنْهَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ وَفِيهَا نُعِيدُكُمْ وَمِنْهَا نُخْرِجُكُمْ تَارَةً أُخْرَىٰ
verses.translit: Minhaa khalaqnaakum wa feehaa nu'eedukum wa minhaa nukhrijukum taaratan ukhraa
verses.translation: Thereof We created you, and thereunto We return you, and thence We bring you forth a second time.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَدْ أَرَيْنَٰهُ ءَايَٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبَىٰ
verses.translit: Wa laqad arainaahu Aayaatinaa kullahaa fakaz zaba wa abaa
verses.translation: And We verily did show him all Our tokens, but he denied them and refused.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتُخْرِجَنَا مِنْ أَرْضِنَا بِسِحْرِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.translit: Qaala aji'tanaa litukhri janaa min ardinaa bisihrika yaa Moosa
verses.translation: He said: Hast come to drive us out from our land by thy magic, O Moses?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحْرٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦ فَٱجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّا نُخْلِفُهُۥ نَحْنُ وَلَآ أَنتَ مَكَانًۭا سُوًۭى
verses.translit: Falanaatiyannaka bisihrim mislihee faj'al bainanaa wa bainaka maw'idal laa nukhlifuhoo nahnu wa laaa anta makaanan suwaa
verses.translation: But we surely can produce for thee magic the like thereof; so appoint a tryst between us and you, which neither we nor thou shall fail to keep, at a place convenient (to us both).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ مَوْعِدُكُمْ يَوْمُ ٱلزِّينَةِ وَأَن يُحْشَرَ ٱلنَّاسُ ضُحًۭى
verses.translit: Qaala maw'idukum yawmuz zeenati wa ai yuhsharan naasu duhaa
verses.translation: (Moses) said: Your tryst shall be the day of the feast, and let the people assemble when the sun hath risen high.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَتَوَلَّىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيْدَهُۥ ثُمَّ أَتَىٰ
verses.translit: Fatawallaa Fir'awnu fajjama'a kaidahoo summa ataa
verses.translation: Then Pharaoh went and gathered his strength, then came (to the appointed tryst).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ وَيْلَكُمْ لَا تَفْتَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا فَيُسْحِتَكُم بِعَذَابٍۢ ۖ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ
verses.translit: Qaala lahum Moosaa wailakum laa taftaroo 'alal laahi kaziban fa yus hitakum bi 'azaab, wa qad khaaba manif taraa
verses.translation: Moses said unto them: Woe unto you! Invent not a lie against Allah, lest He extirpate you by some punishment. He who lieth faileth miserably.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَتَنَٰزَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّجْوَىٰ
verses.translit: Fatanaaza'ooo amrahum bainahum wa asarrun najwaa
verses.translation: Then they debated one with another what they must do, and they kept their counsel secret.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَٰنِ لَسَٰحِرَٰنِ يُرِيدَانِ أَن يُخْرِجَاكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِمَا وَيَذْهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ ٱلْمُثْلَىٰ
verses.translit: Qaalooo in haaazaani lasaahiraani yureedaani ai yukhrijaakum min ardikum bisihrihimaa wa yazhabaa bitareeqatikumul muslaa
verses.translation: They said: Lo! these are two wizards who would drive you out from your country by their magic, and destroy your best traditions;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَجْمِعُوا۟ كَيْدَكُمْ ثُمَّ ٱئْتُوا۟ صَفًّۭا ۚ وَقَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْيَوْمَ مَنِ ٱسْتَعْلَىٰ
verses.translit: Fa ajmi'oo kaidakum summma'too saffaa; wa qad aflahal yawma manis ta'laa
verses.translation: So arrange your plan, and come in battle line. Whoso is uppermost this day will be indeed successful.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوا۟ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِمَّآ أَن تُلْقِىَ وَإِمَّآ أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَلْقَىٰ
verses.translit: Qaaloo yaa Moosaaa immaaa an tulqiya wa immaaa an nakoona awala man alqaa
verses.translation: They said: O Moses! Either throw first, or let us be the first to throw?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ بَلْ أَلْقُوا۟ ۖ فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمْ وَعِصِيُّهُمْ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْهِ مِن سِحْرِهِمْ أَنَّهَا تَسْعَىٰ
verses.translit: Qaala bal alqoo fa izaa hibaaluhum wa 'isiyyuhum yuhaiyalu ilaihi min sihrihim annahaa tas'aa
verses.translation: He said: Nay, do ye throw! Then lo! their cords and their staves, by their magic, appeared to him as though they ran.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَوْجَسَ فِى نَفْسِهِۦ خِيفَةًۭ مُّوسَىٰ
verses.translit: Fa awjasa fee nafsihee kheefatam Moosa
verses.translation: And Moses conceived a fear in his mind.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْنَا لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
verses.translit: Qulnaa laa takhaf innaka antal a'laa
verses.translation: We said: Fear not! Lo! thou art the higher.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَلْقِ مَا فِى يَمِينِكَ تَلْقَفْ مَا صَنَعُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّمَا صَنَعُوا۟ كَيْدُ سَٰحِرٍۢ ۖ وَلَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلسَّاحِرُ حَيْثُ أَتَىٰ
verses.translit: Wa alqi maa fee yamee nika talqaf maa sana'oo; innamaa sana'oo kaidu saahir; wa laa yuflihus saahiru haisu ataa
verses.translation: Throw that which is in thy right hand! It will eat up that which they have made. Lo! that which they have made is but a wizard's artifice, and a wizard shall not be successful to whatever point (of skill) he may attain.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verses.translit: Fa ulqiyas saharatu sujjadan qaalooo aamannaa bi Rabbi Haaroona wa Moosa
verses.translation: Then the wizards were (all) flung down prostrate, crying: We believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ ۖ فَلَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَٰفٍۢ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ فِى جُذُوعِ ٱلنَّخْلِ وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ أَيُّنَآ أَشَدُّ عَذَابًۭا وَأَبْقَىٰ
verses.translit: Qaala aamantum lahoo qabla an aazana lakum; innahoo lakabeerukumul lazee 'allama kumus sihra fala uqatti'anna aidiyakum wa arjulakum min khilaafinw wa la usallibannakum fee juzoo'in nakhli wa lata'lamunna aiyunaaa ashaddu 'azaabanw wa abqaa
verses.translation: (Pharaoh) said: Ye put faith in him before I give you leave. Lo! he is your chief who taught you magic. Now surely I shall cut off your hands and your feet alternately, and I shall crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, and ye shall know for certain which of us hath sterner and more lasting punishment.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْثِرَكَ عَلَىٰ مَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنَا ۖ فَٱقْضِ مَآ أَنتَ قَاضٍ ۖ إِنَّمَا تَقْضِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَآ
verses.translit: Qaaloo lan nu'siraka 'alaa maa jaaa'anaa minal baiyinaati wallazee fataranaa faqdi maaa anta qaad; innamaa taqdee haazihil hayaatad dunyaa
verses.translation: They said: We choose thee not above the clear proofs that have come unto us, and above Him Who created us. So decree what thou wilt decree. Thou wilt end for us only this life of the world.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّآ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّنَا لِيَغْفِرَ لَنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَا وَمَآ أَكْرَهْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلسِّحْرِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
verses.translit: Innaaa aamannaa bi Rabbinaa liyaghfira lanaa khataayaanaa wa maaa akrahtanaa 'alaihi minas sihr; wallaahu khairunw waabqaa
verses.translation: Lo! we believe in our Lord, that He may forgive us our sins and the magic unto which thou didst force us. Allah is better and more lasting.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّهُۥ مَن يَأْتِ رَبَّهُۥ مُجْرِمًۭا فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
verses.translit: Innahoo mai yaati Rabbahoo mujriman fa inna lahoo Jahannama laa yamotu feehaa wa laa yahyaa
verses.translation: Lo! whoso cometh guilty unto his Lord, verily for him is hell. There he will neither die nor live.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَن يَأْتِهِۦ مُؤْمِنًۭا قَدْ عَمِلَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلدَّرَجَٰتُ ٱلْعُلَىٰ
verses.translit: Wa mai yaatihee mu'minan qad 'amilas saalihaati fa ulaaa'ika lahumud dara jaatul 'ulaa
verses.translation: But whoso cometh unto Him a believer, having done good works, for such are the high stations;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
verses.translit: Jannaatu 'Adnin tajree min tahtihal anhaaru khaalideena feehaa; wa zaalika jazaaa'ua man tazakka
verses.translation: Gardens of Eden underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide for ever. That is the reward of him who groweth.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى فَٱضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًۭا فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ يَبَسًۭا لَّا تَخَٰفُ دَرَكًۭا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ
verses.translit: Wa laqad awhainaaa ilaa Moosaaa an asri bi'ibaadee fadrib lahum tareeqan fil bahri yabasal laa takhaafu darakanw wa laa takhshaa
verses.translation: And verily We inspired Moses, saying: Take away My slaves by night and strike for them a dry path in the sea, fearing not to be overtaken, neither being afraid (of the sea).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ بِجُنُودِهِۦ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمْ
verses.translit: Fa atba'ahum Fir'awnu bijunoodihee faghashiyahum minal yammmi maa ghashi yahum
verses.translation: Then Pharaoh followed them with his hosts and there covered them that which did cover them of the sea.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَضَلَّ فِرْعَوْنُ قَوْمَهُۥ وَمَا هَدَىٰ
verses.translit: wa adalla fir'awnu qawmahoo wa maa hadaa
verses.translation: And Pharaoh led his folk astray, he did not guide them.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ قَدْ أَنجَيْنَٰكُم مِّنْ عَدُوِّكُمْ وَوَٰعَدْنَٰكُمْ جَانِبَ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنَ وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَنَّ وَٱلسَّلْوَىٰ
verses.translit: Yaa Baneee Israaa'eela qad anjainaakum min 'aduw wikum wa wa'adnaakum jaanibat Tooril aimana wa nazzalnaa 'alaikumul Manna was Salwaa
verses.translation: O Children of Israel! We delivered you from your enemy, and we made a covenant with you on the holy mountain's side, and sent down on you the manna and the quails,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كُلُوا۟ مِن طَيِّبَٰتِ مَا رَزَقْنَٰكُمْ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِيهِ فَيَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبِى ۖ وَمَن يَحْلِلْ عَلَيْهِ غَضَبِى فَقَدْ هَوَىٰ
verses.translit: Kuloo min taiyibaati maa razaqnaakum wa laa tatghaw feehi fa yahilla 'alaikum ghadabee wa mai yahlil 'alaihi ghadabee faqad hawaa
verses.translation: (Saying): Eat of the good things wherewith We have provided you, and transgress not in respect thereof lest My wrath come upon you: and he on whom My wrath cometh, he is lost indeed.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِنِّى لَغَفَّارٌۭ لِّمَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا ثُمَّ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
verses.translit: Wa innee la Ghaffaarul liman taaba wa aamana wa 'amila saalihan summah tadaa
verses.translation: And lo! verily I am Forgiving toward him who repenteth and believeth and doeth good, and afterward walketh aright.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ وَمَآ أَعْجَلَكَ عَن قَوْمِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.translit: Wa maaa a'jalaka 'an qawmika yaa Moosa
verses.translation: And (it was said): What hath made thee hasten from thy folk, O Moses?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ هُمْ أُو۟لَآءِ عَلَىٰٓ أَثَرِى وَعَجِلْتُ إِلَيْكَ رَبِّ لِتَرْضَىٰ
verses.translit: Qaala hum ulaaa'i 'alaaa asaree wa 'ajiltu ilaika Rabbi litardaa
verses.translation: He said: They are close upon my track. I hastened unto Thee, my Lord, that Thou mightest be well pleased.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
verses.translit: Qaala fa innaa qad fatannaa qawmaka mim ba'dika wa adallahumus Saamiriyy
verses.translation: He said: Lo! We have tried thy folk in thine absence, and As-Samiri hath misled them.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَرَجَعَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ غَضْبَٰنَ أَسِفًۭا ۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ أَلَمْ يَعِدْكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ وَعْدًا حَسَنًا ۚ أَفَطَالَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْعَهْدُ أَمْ أَرَدتُّمْ أَن يَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ فَأَخْلَفْتُم مَّوْعِدِى
verses.translit: Faraja's Moosaaa ilaa qawmihee ghadbaana asifaa; qaala yaa qawmi alam ya'idkum Rabbukum wa'dan hasanaa; afataala 'alaikumul 'ahdu am arattum ai yahilla 'alaikum ghadabum mir Rabbikum fa akhlaftum maw'idee
verses.translation: Then Moses went back unto his folk, angry and sad. He said: O my people! Hath not your Lord promised you a fair promise? Did the time appointed then appear too long for you, or did ye wish that wrath from your Lord should come upon you, that ye broke tryst with me?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَخْلَفْنَا مَوْعِدَكَ بِمَلْكِنَا وَلَٰكِنَّا حُمِّلْنَآ أَوْزَارًۭا مِّن زِينَةِ ٱلْقَوْمِ فَقَذَفْنَٰهَا فَكَذَٰلِكَ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
verses.translit: Qaaloo maaa akhlafnaa maw'idaka bimalkinna wa laakinna hummilnaaa awzaaram min zeenatil qawmi faqazafnaahaa fakazaalika alqas Saamiriyy
verses.translation: They said: We broke not tryst with thee of our own will, but we were laden with burdens of ornaments of the folk, then cast them (in the fire), for thus As-Samiri proposed.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَخْرَجَ لَهُمْ عِجْلًۭا جَسَدًۭا لَّهُۥ خُوَارٌۭ فَقَالُوا۟ هَٰذَآ إِلَٰهُكُمْ وَإِلَٰهُ مُوسَىٰ فَنَسِىَ
verses.translit: Fa akhraja lahum 'ijlan jasadal lahoo khuwaarun faqaaloo haazaaa ilaahukum wa ilaahu Moosaa fanasee
verses.translation: Then he produced for them a calf, of saffron hue, which gave forth a lowing sound. And they cried: This is your god and the god of Moses, but he hath forgotten.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَلَّا يَرْجِعُ إِلَيْهِمْ قَوْلًۭا وَلَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ ضَرًّۭا وَلَا نَفْعًۭا
verses.translit: Afalaa yarawna allaa yarji'u ilaihim qawlanw wa laa yamliku lahum darranw wa laa naf'aa
verses.translation: See they not, then, that it returneth no saying unto them and possesseth for them neither hurt nor use?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَدْ قَالَ لَهُمْ هَٰرُونُ مِن قَبْلُ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنَّمَا فُتِنتُم بِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ فَٱتَّبِعُونِى وَأَطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرِى
verses.translit: Wa laqad qaala lahum Haaroonu min qablu yaa qawmi innamaa futintum bihee wa inna Rabbakumur Rahmaanu fattabi'oonee wa atee'ooo amree
verses.translation: And Aaron indeed had told them beforehand: O my people! Ye are but being seduced therewith, for lo! your Lord is the Beneficent, so follow me and obey my order.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوا۟ لَن نَّبْرَحَ عَلَيْهِ عَٰكِفِينَ حَتَّىٰ يَرْجِعَ إِلَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ
verses.translit: Qaaloo lan nabraha 'alaihi 'aakifeena hattaa yarji'a ilainaa Moosaa
verses.translation: They said: We shall by no means cease to be its votaries till Moses return unto us.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ يَٰهَٰرُونُ مَا مَنَعَكَ إِذْ رَأَيْتَهُمْ ضَلُّوٓا۟
verses.translit: Qaala Yaa Haaroonu maa mana 'aka iz ra aitahum dallooo
verses.translation: He (Moses) said: O Aaron! What held thee back when thou didst see them gone astray,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَلَّا تَتَّبِعَنِ ۖ أَفَعَصَيْتَ أَمْرِى
verses.translit: Allaa tattabi'ani afa'asaita amree
verses.translation: That thou followedst me not? Hast thou then disobeyed my order?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ يَبْنَؤُمَّ لَا تَأْخُذْ بِلِحْيَتِى وَلَا بِرَأْسِىٓ ۖ إِنِّى خَشِيتُ أَن تَقُولَ فَرَّقْتَ بَيْنَ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَمْ تَرْقُبْ قَوْلِى
verses.translit: Qaala yabna'umma laa taakhuz bilihyatee wa laa biraasee innee khashetu an taqoola farraqta baina Baneee Israaa'eela wa lam tarqub qawlee
verses.translation: He said: O son of my mother! Clutch not my beard nor my head! I feared lest thou shouldst say: Thou hast caused division among the Children of Israel, and hast not waited for my word.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكَ يَٰسَٰمِرِىُّ
verses.translit: Qaala famaa khatbuka yaa Saamiriyy
verses.translation: (Moses) said: And what hast thou to say, O Samiri?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ بَصُرْتُ بِمَا لَمْ يَبْصُرُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَقَبَضْتُ قَبْضَةًۭ مِّنْ أَثَرِ ٱلرَّسُولِ فَنَبَذْتُهَا وَكَذَٰلِكَ سَوَّلَتْ لِى نَفْسِى
verses.translit: Qaala basurtu bimaa lam yabsuroo bihee faqabadtu qabdatam min asarir Rasooli fanabaztuhaa wa kazaalika sawwalat lee nafsee
verses.translation: He said: I perceived what they perceive not, so I seized a handful from the footsteps of the messenger, and then threw it in. Thus my soul commended to me.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verses.translit: Qaala fazhab fa inna laka fil hayaati an taqoola laa misaasa wa inna laka maw'idal lan tukhlafahoo wanzur ilaaa ilaahikal lazee zalta 'alaihi 'aakifaa; lanuharriqannnahoo summa lanansifanahoo fil yammi nasfaa
verses.translation: (Moses) said: Then go! and lo! in this life it is for thee to say: Touch me not! and lo! there is for thee a tryst thou canst not break. Now look upon thy god of which thou hast remained a votary. Verily we will burn it and will scatter its dust over the sea.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًۭا
verses.translit: Innamaaa ilaahukkumul laahul lazee laa ilaaha illaa Hoo; wasi'a kulla shai'in ilmaa
verses.translation: Your Allah is only Allah, than Whom there is no other Allah. He embraceth all things in His knowledge.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كَذَٰلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ مَا قَدْ سَبَقَ ۚ وَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَٰكَ مِن لَّدُنَّا ذِكْرًۭا
verses.translit: Kazaalika naqussu 'alaika min ambaaa'i maa qad sabaq; wa qad aatainaaka mil ladunnaa Zikraa
verses.translation: Thus relate We unto thee (Muhammad) some tidings of that which happened of old, and We have given thee from Our presence a reminder.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مَّنْ أَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَحْمِلُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وِزْرًا
verses.translit: Man a'rada 'anhu, fa innahoo yahmilu Yawmal Qiyaamati wizraa
verses.translation: Whoso turneth away from it, he verily will bear a burden on the Day of Resurrection,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهِ ۖ وَسَآءَ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ حِمْلًۭا
verses.translit: Khaalideena feehi wa saaa'a lahum Yawmal Qiyaamati himlaa
verses.translation: Abiding under it - an evil burden for them on the Day of Resurrection,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ وَنَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ زُرْقًۭا
verses.translit: Yawma yunfakhu fissoori wa nahshurul mujrimeena Yawma 'izin zurqaa
verses.translation: The day when the Trumpet is blown. On that day we assemble the guilty white-eyed (with terror),
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَتَخَٰفَتُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا عَشْرًۭا
verses.translit: Yatakhaafatoona bainahum il labistum illaa 'ashraa
verses.translation: Murmuring among themselves: Ye have tarried but ten (days).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذْ يَقُولُ أَمْثَلُهُمْ طَرِيقَةً إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا يَوْمًۭا
verses.translit: nahnu a'lamu bimaa yaqooloona iz yaqoolu amsaluhum tareeqatan illabistum illaa yawmaa
verses.translation: We are Best Aware of what they utter when their best in conduct say: Ye have tarried but a day.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلْجِبَالِ فَقُلْ يَنسِفُهَا رَبِّى نَسْفًۭا
verses.translit: Wa yas'aloonaka 'anil jibaali faqul yansifuhaa Rabbee nasfaa
verses.translation: They will ask thee of the mountains (on that day). Say: My Lord will break them into scattered dust.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَيَذَرُهَا قَاعًۭا صَفْصَفًۭا
verses.translit: Fa yazaruhaa qaa'an safsafaa
verses.translation: And leave it as an empty plain,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَّا تَرَىٰ فِيهَا عِوَجًۭا وَلَآ أَمْتًۭا
verses.translit: Laa taraa feehaa 'iwajanw wa laaa amtaa
verses.translation: Wherein thou seest neither curve nor ruggedness.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَتَّبِعُونَ ٱلدَّاعِىَ لَا عِوَجَ لَهُۥ ۖ وَخَشَعَتِ ٱلْأَصْوَاتُ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ فَلَا تَسْمَعُ إِلَّا هَمْسًۭا
verses.translit: Yawma iziny yattabi'oonad daa'iya laa 'iwaja lahoo wa khasha'atil aswaatu lir Rahmaani falaa tasma'u illaa hamsaa
verses.translation: On that day they follow the summoner who deceiveth not, and voices are hushed for the Beneficent, and thou hearest but a faint murmur.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا تَنفَعُ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَرَضِىَ لَهُۥ قَوْلًۭا
verses.translit: Yawma 'izil laa tanfa'ush shafaa'atu illaa man azina lahur Rahmaanu wa radiya lahoo qawlaa
verses.translation: On that day no intercession availeth save (that of) him unto whom the Beneficent hath given leave and whose word He accepteth.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِهِۦ عِلْمًۭا
verses.translit: Ya'lamu maa bainaa aideehim wa maa khalfahum wa laa yauheetoona bihee 'ilmaa
verses.translation: He knoweth (all) that is before them and (all) that is behind them, while they cannot compass it in knowledge.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ وَعَنَتِ ٱلْوُجُوهُ لِلْحَىِّ ٱلْقَيُّومِ ۖ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ حَمَلَ ظُلْمًۭا
verses.translit: Wa 'anatil wujoohu lil Haiiyil Qaiyoomi wa qad khaaba man hamala zulmaa
verses.translation: And faces humble themselves before the Living, the Eternal. And he who beareth (a burden of) wrongdoing is indeed a failure (on that day).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌۭ فَلَا يَخَافُ ظُلْمًۭا وَلَا هَضْمًۭا
verses.translit: Wa mai ya'mal minas saalihaati wa huwa mu'minun falaa yakhaafu zulmanw wa laa hadmaa
verses.translation: And he who hath done some good works, being a believer, he feareth not injustice nor begrudging (of his wage).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّۭا وَصَرَّفْنَا فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلْوَعِيدِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ أَوْ يُحْدِثُ لَهُمْ ذِكْرًۭا
verses.translit: Wa kazaalika anzalnaahu Qur-aanan 'Arabiyyanw wa sarrafnaa fee hi minal wa'eedi la'allahum yattaqoona aw yuhdisu lahum zikraa
verses.translation: Thus we have revealed it as a Lecture in Arabic, and have displayed therein certain threats, that peradventure they may keep from evil or that it may cause them to take heed.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۗ وَلَا تَعْجَلْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُقْضَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ وَحْيُهُۥ ۖ وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدْنِى عِلْمًۭا
verses.translit: Fata'aalal laahul Malikul Haqq; wa laa ta'jal bil Quraani min qabli ai yuqdaaa ilaika wahyuhoo wa qur Rabbi zidnee 'ilmaa
verses.translation: Then exalted be Allah, the True King! And hasten not (O Muhammad) with the Qur'an ere its revelation hath been perfected unto thee, and say: My Lord! Increase me in knowledge.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَدْ عَهِدْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ ءَادَمَ مِن قَبْلُ فَنَسِىَ وَلَمْ نَجِدْ لَهُۥ عَزْمًۭا
verses.translit: Wa laqad 'ahidnaaa ilaaa Aadama min qablu fanasiya wa lam najid lahoo 'azmaa
verses.translation: And verily We made a covenant of old with Adam, but he forgot, and We found no constancy in him.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِءَادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰ
verses.translit: Wa iz qulnaa lilma laaa'ikatis judoo li Aadama fasajadooo illaaa Iblees; abaa
verses.translation: And when We said unto the angels: Fall prostrate before Adam, they fell prostrate (all) save Iblis; he refused.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَقُلْنَا يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ إِنَّ هَٰذَا عَدُوٌّۭ لَّكَ وَلِزَوْجِكَ فَلَا يُخْرِجَنَّكُمَا مِنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ فَتَشْقَىٰٓ
verses.translit: Faqulnaa yaaa Aadamu inna haazaa 'aduwwul laka wa lizawjika falaa yukhrijan nakumaa minal Jannati fatashqaa
verses.translation: Therefor we said: O Adam! This is an enemy unto thee and unto thy wife, so let him not drive you both out of the Garden so that thou come to toil.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ لَكَ أَلَّا تَجُوعَ فِيهَا وَلَا تَعْرَىٰ
verses.translit: Innaa laka allaa tajoo'a feeha wa laa ta'raa
verses.translation: It is (vouchsafed) unto thee that thou hungerest not therein nor art naked,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنَّكَ لَا تَظْمَؤُا۟ فِيهَا وَلَا تَضْحَىٰ
verses.translit: Wa annaka laa tazma'u feehaa wa laa tadhaa
verses.translation: And that thou thirstest not therein nor art exposed to the sun's heat.
